# Janhavi Dhote

Georgia Tech Computer Engineering student building across software systems, AI, embedded computing, networking, hardware, and security.

## Focus areas

- Computer engineering
- Distributed systems, cloud, and computer networks
- Embedded systems and hardware-software integration
- FPGA and digital design
- AI and computer vision
- Databases, software-defined radio, robotics, and security

## Selected work

- [CuraLink](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/curalink): In-the-moment visual and voice assistance for people with Alzheimer’s, with caregiver oversight.
- [Office Hours Queue & TA Kiosk](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/office-hours-kiosk): A Raspberry Pi check-in, staffing, and student queue system for engineering office hours.
- [GreenBuy](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/greenbuy): Neighborhood-scale collective purchasing for sustainability upgrades.
- [Custom Math Unit – FPGA Peripheral](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/fpga-math-unit): A custom FPGA processor peripheral implementing hardware arithmetic and processor communication.
- [Embedded Game System](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/embedded-game): A real-time game engine and 40 × 25 world rendered on constrained Mbed hardware.
- [LifeLens](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/lifelens): Health risk models, conversational assistance, and provider discovery in one prototype.
- [Research Radar](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/research-radar): A local reader for collecting, deduplicating, organizing, and briefing research sources.
- [IntentGuard](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/intentguard): Exploring safer intent translation between BCI decoding and AI-driven actions.

## Experience

- [ECE 1100 Discovery Studio Peer Leader Fellowship — Georgia Tech ECE](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/ece1100-peer-leader): I help first-year ECE students through Discovery Studio as they get used to classes, engineering, and campus resources.
- [CS 4400 Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Tech · CS 4400, Introduction to Database Systems](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/cs4400-uta): I help students with SQL, relational schemas, database design, and course assignments.
- [ECE 2035 Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Tech · ECE 2035, Programming for Hardware/Software Systems](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/ece2035-uta): I helped students debug C, assembly, and hardware/software problems during the summer.
- [CS 2340 Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Tech · CS 2340, Objects & Design](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/cs2340-uta): I supported about 150 students with Java, Android, object-oriented design, and debugging.
- [Science Olympiad · Event Supervisor and Exam Author — Science Olympiad at Georgia Tech](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/science-olympiad-gt): I co-wrote Machines and Remote Sensing exams with a friend and helped supervise the events at Tech's invitational and the Georgia state tournament.
- [Roommate Finder · Project Co-Lead — Georgia Tech mobile development club (GITMAD)](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/gitmad-roommate-finder): I co-led a Roommate Finder project group of about eight students and helped coordinate the team's app development.
- [Ground Operations Engineer · Small Satellite Research Laboratory — University of Georgia · Small Satellite Research Laboratory](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/small-satellite-research-lab): I worked with GNU Radio SDR pipelines and C image encoding/decoding, tracing problems through low-level data and signal processing.
- [Assistant Teacher · Stock Market Class — Double Helix STEAM School](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/double-helix): I prepared weekly market-news material and helped students connect earnings and current events to investing concepts.
- [Science Olympiad at UGA · Geologic Mapping Exam Author — Science Olympiad at the University of Georgia](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/science-olympiad-uga): I wrote a Geologic Mapping exam for a UGA invitational, drawing on my experience competing in Science Olympiad.
- [Med-Perplexity · Software Development — InpharmD · work-based-learning placement / internship](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/inpharmd): I worked on a Next.js interface for a medical AI chatbot and helped connect it to cloud-backed services.
- [Software Development · Digitivy Solutions — Digitivy Solutions · work-based learning](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/digitivy): I worked on React dashboard components, Node.js APIs, databases, and parts of the AWS deployment workflow.
- [Business Development Representative · Adesso Network — Adesso Network](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/adesso-network): I worked on partnership outreach, contract onboarding, and communication with outside organizations.
- [Techno Titans Robotics · Subsystems Programmer — Techno Titans Robotics](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/techno-titans): I programmed drivetrain systems using Java/WPILib, built debugging testbeds, and mentored newer robotics programmers.
- [STEM Summer Robotics Camp · Programming Lead and Teacher — Techno Titans community outreach](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/stem-robotics-camp): I helped teach robot programming to younger students and guided hands-on activities at summer camps.
- [SEWA Health Web · Volunteer Project Lead — SEWA volunteer organization](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/sewa-health-web): I coordinated a team working on a health-focused website for SEWA members.
- [SEWA Community Events · Volunteer — SEWA community outreach](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/sewa-volunteer): I volunteered at community events, including helping with food-ticketing and event operations.
